Creates runtime batchers from resolved dataset partitions.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Data Pipeline](../categories/data-pipeline.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `DataLoader` |
| Search words | batch, loader, dataloader, shuffle, epoch, training |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Partitions** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Resolved partition set from Data Split |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Batched training features |
| **Labels** | Labels | No | 1 | Batched training labels |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Training | epochs | `epochs` | Integer | `10` | `1-10000` | The run | Training epochs. |
| Training | batch_size | `batch_size` | Integer | `32` | `1-100000` | The run | Samples per batch. |
| Training | shuffle | `shuffle` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Shuffle training batches. |
| Training | drop_last | `drop_last` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Drop incomplete final batch. |
| Runtime | num_workers | `num_workers` | Integer | `0` | `0-128` | The run | Worker count for batch preparation. Advanced. |
| Runtime | prefetch_factor | `prefetch_factor` | Integer | `2` | `0-64` | The run | Prefetch factor when workers are active. Advanced. |
| Training | log_interval | `log_interval` | Integer | `10` | `0-100000` | The run | Training metric and log interval in batches. Advanced. |
| Training | validation_freq | `validation_freq` | Integer | `1` | `1-10000` | The run | Validation frequency in epochs. Advanced. |
| Training | seed | `seed` | Integer | `42` | `0-2147483647` | The run | Batching random seed. Advanced. |
| Training | model_seed | `model_seed` | Integer | `-1` | `-1-2147483647` | The run | Model RNG seed: -1 leaves unset; seeds fresh-run ArrayFire initialization and dropout, not checkpoint continuation. Advanced. |
| Training | grad_accum_steps | `grad_accum_steps` | Integer | `1` | `1-100000` | The run | Gradient accumulation steps. Advanced. |
| Generation previews | generation_preview_enabled | `generation_preview_enabled` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Generate samples while training. Prompts, chat template, stop texts and decoding are on the Data Loader's Generation tab. |
| Generation previews | generation_preview_mode | `generation_preview_mode` | Choice | `continuation` | `continuation`, `chat` | The run | continuation for a base model; chat for an instruction-tuned one (uses the chat template) |
| Generation previews | generation_preview_max_new_tokens | `generation_preview_max_new_tokens` | Integer | `64` | `1-1024` | The run | Maximum generated tokens per prompt. |
| Generation previews | generation_preview_every | `generation_preview_every` | Integer | `1` | `1-1000000` | The run | Generate every N epochs or optimizer steps. |
| Generation previews | generation_preview_every_unit | `generation_preview_every_unit` | Choice | `epochs` | `epochs`, `steps` | The run | What Every counts. |
| Balancing | balance_classes | `balance_classes` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Apply training-only class balancing. Advanced. |
| Balancing | balance_mode | `balance_mode` | Choice | `none` | `none`, `oversample`, `undersample`, `weighted_sampler` | The run | Class balancing mode. Advanced. |
| Balancing | balance_target | `balance_target` | Text | `max` |   | The run | Class balancing target. Advanced. |
| Balancing | balance_seed | `balance_seed` | Integer | `42` | `0-2147483647` | The run | Class balancing seed. Advanced. |
| Checkpoint | save_best_checkpoint | `save_best_checkpoint` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Save best validation checkpoint. Advanced. |
| Checkpoint | early_stopping_patience | `early_stopping_patience` | Integer | `5` | `0-10000` | The run | Early stopping patience in validation checks. Advanced. |
| Checkpoint | checkpoint_dir | `checkpoint_dir` | Folder | (empty) |   | The run | Checkpoint output directory. Advanced. |
| Checkpoint | Start from | `initialize_from_checkpoint` | Folder | (empty) |   | The run | A checkpoint folder from an earlier run (for example checkpoints/&lt;run>/train-&lt;id>/best). Its weights become this model's starting point (warm start): every layer starts from the trained values and keeps training on this run's data (full fine-tuning; no layers are frozen). Only the weights are loaded: the optimizer, learning-rate schedule, epochs and random seed start fresh. Layer names and shapes, and for language models the tokenizer, must match the checkpoint exactly, or the run stops with the reason and the model is left untouched. New checkpoints record this folder as initialized_from. Empty = start from random weights. Advanced. |
| Checkpoint | Start from weights file | `initialize_from_weights_file` | File | (empty) |   | The run | A published weight file: a PyTorch state-dict (.pth, .pt) or a .safetensors file. A layer takes the entries named after its node (node conv1 takes conv1.weight), with PyTorch's layouts converted. A layer the file has no fitting weights for starts fresh, and the run says which; the run stops only when no layer matches. The file is read as data and never run. Optimizer, schedule, epochs and seed start fresh. Use this or Start from, not both. Empty = not used. Advanced. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a training control |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Consumes one Partitions Dataset contract and emits model-facing batched Data/Labels.
```

## Tips

- Training shuffle/balancing applies to Train only.
- Validation and Test are resolved from the partition manifest, not separate canvas branches.
